verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Unleash SDKs connect via API tokens and Unleash Edge acts as a caching layer that reduces load on the primary instance and serves thousands of SDKs, implying a poll-and-cache architecture, but no evidence explicitly states that SDKs evaluate flags fully locally with zero network calls per check or quantifies microsecond-level evaluation speed. Missing for 10: explicit SDK docs describing local/in-memory rule evaluation, polling interval mechanics, and performance/latency benchmarks for local evaluation.
